## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      15 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 20 avr. 2026 - 18 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Yacyii_, 18 sept. 2026, 1/5: "The performance on iPad is TERRIBLE. The screen keeps randomly jumping from one place to another, and there are so many bugs that it’s really difficult to work with the app comfortably. It’s extremely frustrating and honestly makes the whole experience exhausting. I’m using a 2025 iPad, so I really don’t think this should be happening. Please fix the iPad experience and these annoying bugs!"
            2. _Professor GT_, 16 sept. 2026, 1/5: "I was using notion and it is a good tool for what I needed it for, but then all of a sudden one day my page was frozen behind a pay wall. The pay option has options I will never use. I’m not paying around $25 a month for this software, the ai feature is not close to worth it and I’ve wasted time using features that were once free."
            3. _.oliviaaa_, 15 août 2026, 1/5: "There's a lot of issues on mobile compared to the desktop version. For example, when you select a paragraph and try to delete it instead of holding down the delete button, it doesn't delete. Sometimes even when you hold down the delete button, a letter or two doesn't get deleted. It's generally laggy and without a premium subscription, you can't even upload a single video as the file max is 10mb and most videos are over that. You have to find a site and register to embed the videos instead. Overall greedy platform. Used to be good until it became buggy and you're can't upload a video without the app's premium subscription being shoved down your throat."
